card.title: VALENTINE Mk III
card.flavorText: The Valentine Mk III was a British made infantry tank, developed by Vickers and used during WWII. More than 8,000 Valentines were produced, from 1 up to 11 Marks, including many variants which made it account for almost a quarter of all British tanks produced during the war. The tank was supplied in large numbers to the USSR and other Allies, and it  proved to be both strong and reliable. The Mk III had a crew of 4 (commander, gunner, driver and a loader), main armament of a QF 2-pounder (40 mm) and secondary armament of a 7.92 mm BESA machine-gun. There are several explanations for the name and according to the most popular one is that the design was presented to the War Office on St. Valentine's Day, February 14, 1940.
